create_euler_discrete_scheduler: create an EulerDiscreteScheduler instance with configurable beta schedule, prediction type, and Karras sigmas for diffusion model inference
set_timesteps_euler_discrete: set the discrete timesteps and sigmas for the EulerDiscreteScheduler before running the denoising inference loop
step_euler_discrete: perform one denoising step with the EulerDiscreteScheduler using model output, current timestep, and sample to predict the previous sample
add_noise_euler_discrete: add noise to original samples at specified timesteps using the EulerDiscreteScheduler noise schedule for training or image-to-image tasks
build_beta_schedule: build a beta schedule tensor from a cosine, exponential, or Laplace alpha transform function for diffusion model noise scheduling
